style: Y2K bio-punk, year-2000 consumer electronics fused with mutated insect anatomy, translucent candy-colored plastic, neon magenta and acid green accents, game-ready low-poly asset, clean silhouette, single object centered, no base, no background

assets.name: neon_cicada
assets.prompt: A mutated cicada the size of a dog, body built from a translucent iMac-style plastic shell in magenta, two large orange glowing compound eyes, four translucent wings with circuit traces, six spindly black legs, menacing, hovering pose
assets.texture_prompt: glossy translucent magenta plastic shell, orange emissive eyes, faint green circuit traces on the wings, grime and scratches

assets.name: sludge_roach
assets.prompt: A mutated giant cockroach, low flattened body, segmented orange-brown chitin shell with a magenta underglow seam, head wedge with two antennae, six strong jointed legs, crouched ready-to-pounce pose, facing forward
assets.texture_prompt: oily orange-brown chitin, magenta emissive seams between the plates, wet sludge drips, dirt

assets.name: kiosk_turret
assets.prompt: A derelict shopping-mall information kiosk corrupted into a turret: a beige late-1990s CRT monitor box on a pedestal, a short mortar barrel protruding from the screen, a bent radio antenna with a red light on top, cables and insect-like biomass growing out of the vents
assets.texture_prompt: yellowed beige plastic, a glowing green CRT screen with scanlines, rust, magenta biomass growth, exposed cables

assets.name: dial_up_queen
assets.prompt: A massive insect queen boss fused with a 56k dial-up modem: bloated magenta-violet thorax shaped like a modem chassis with blinking LED rows, two tall antenna rods, four huge translucent cyan wings with circuit patterns, a crown of phone cables, regal and threatening pose
assets.texture_prompt: glossy magenta-violet plastic chitin, rows of green and amber LEDs, translucent cyan wings with glowing circuit traces, grey phone cables

assets.name: mall_kiosk
assets.prompt: A derelict year-2000 shopping mall retail kiosk cart, rectangular counter with a striped canopy, shutter closed, pager and cassette posters peeling off, flood waterline stain at the base
assets.texture_prompt: faded teal and orange laminate, peeling posters, water stains, dust

assets.name: fountain_sculpture
assets.prompt: A shopping mall fountain centerpiece sculpture: a chrome abstract Y2K swoosh spire on a round pedestal, with insect egg sacs clustered around the base
assets.texture_prompt: tarnished chrome, teal patina, translucent green egg sacs with faint glow

assets.name: mall_planter
assets.prompt: A long rectangular shopping mall concrete planter box with dead ferns and a mutated glowing fungus growing out of it, low wall height
assets.texture_prompt: stained concrete, dry brown fern leaves, acid green bioluminescent fungus
